title: AVI Core Closure Experiment 002 — layered state diagnosis
purpose: Test whether the AVI-Core workflow can localize an omitted standard-state carrier class before any ontology extension is considered.
protocol: For each case omit exactly one known standard-state layer, measure the resulting closure defect, then add candidate layers one at a time. The correct carrier must uniquely restore closure.
scientificGuardrail: Successful diagnosis validates the diagnostic workflow only. It is not evidence for an AVI-specific state or for new physics.
